text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The China Securities Regulatory Commission has issued an urgent notice, warning listed firms that any company found including false information in annual reports will be harshly punished.
- Commentary says China's target for an economic growth of eight percent in 1997 is appropriate.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China is expected to continue to allow large amounts of foreign investment in infrastructure projects in the next 10 or 20 years.
- Commentary criticises overlapping of so-called pillar industries by many provinces.
